correspondence.explanation: All original H roots remain. H004 expresses the finite-dimensional irreducible highest-weight representation by its three generator operators, dimension and existence of a highest-weight vector; H005 fixes their Chevalley relations and H006 the chosen vector. H007 states the common integer/complex basis and specifies the unique restricted divided powers XM/YM: original stability supplies these restrictions, and their existence implies stability; closure under the generated integer algebra is equivalent to generator stability. No lattice minimality is imposed. VK is M⊗ℤK with the K-module transported by tensor commutation; T008 proves that this action multiplies the second factor and that ind(f)(m⊗a)=f(m)⊗a, together with the invariant-subspace transport in both directions. Thus Nontrivial VK and the universal zero-or-whole assertion are exactly the full original target. T012 checks the three integral/reduced Chevalley relations, so stability under their K-linear combinations is stability under the stipulated free Chevalley Lie algebra, including characteristic 2. Integers lambda, arbitrary fields of prime characteristic, lambda=0 and p=2 are retained.
